description: aider from PyPI by pipx and by uv on Windows, found by the package its tool directories are named for.
why: The two Windows tool-dir layouts against real installs. aider installs as aider-chat, so a directory named for the command would match nothing; the row names the package, and the pypi route reads the name back under the Windows home root. Run once with --just-check-update, which writes ~\.aider, and each witness is pinned by its own row so none stands in for another. `forbid` names CLI agents whose launchers share ~\.local\bin with aider's.
known_gaps: Run only for its update check: nothing exercises aider working on code.
